Of course. Here is an introduction to Zhejiang Runhe Chemical New Material Co., Ltd.

---

Headquartered in the dynamic city of Hangzhou, a major economic and technological hub in China’s Zhejiang province, Zhejiang Runhe Chemical New Material Co., Ltd. has established itself as a prominent and innovative leader in the specialty chemical industry. Operating from its central location at No. 136, Qingchun Road, the company is at the forefront of the research, development, production, and application of silicone-based new materials, which are critical components in a vast array of modern products.

With a deep commitment to scientific advancement, Runhe Chemical specializes in creating high-performance solutions that serve diverse and demanding sectors. Their product portfolio primarily includes textile finishing agents, agricultural silicones, personal care ingredients, and other specialty silicone compounds. These advanced materials are engineered to enhance the performance, efficiency, and sustainability of end products, from making fabrics softer and more durable to improving the efficacy of crop protection products and formulating next-generation cosmetics.

At its core, Runhe Chemical is driven by a philosophy of innovation and customer-centricity. The company invests heavily in its state-of-the-art R&D facilities, fostering a culture of continuous improvement and technological breakthroughs. This allows them to not only meet but also anticipate the evolving needs of the global market. By providing tailored solutions and expert technical support, Zhejiang Runhe Chemical New Material Co., Ltd. has solidified its reputation as a reliable strategic partner for businesses worldwide, pioneering the future of material science from the heart of Hangzhou.
